nodes.description: Immutable pair reference stored in the UniOracle contract; used as the target of external calls during update and consult.
Address of the sorted token0 of the pair, captured at construction and compared in consult.
Address of the sorted token1 of the pair, captured at construction and used as the fallback branch in consult.
Last stored cumulative price0 value; subtracted from the fresh cumulative to compute the average in update.
Last stored cumulative price1 value; subtracted from the fresh cumulative to compute the average in update.
Timestamp of the last successful update; drives the fixed-window period check and overflow-desired subtraction.
Stored fixed-point average price0 (uq112x112) written by update and read by consult.
Stored fixed-point average price1 (uq112x112) written by update and read by consult.
Mapping from pair address to deployed UniOracle address; queried and written by deploy/update/quote.
Array of all deployed oracle addresses appended in deploy and returned by oracles().
Array of all known pair addresses appended in deploy and returned by pairs().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 factory address used for CREATE2 pair address derivation.
Initializes pair, token0, token1, cumulative prices and blockTimestampLast, and requires non-zero reserves.
External permissionless function that recomputes price averages over the elapsed period and stores them, using block.timestamp deltas.
View function returning the output amount for a token using the stored average price; branches on token0/token1.
Pure function deriving the CREATE2 pair address for two tokens via UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
Deploys a new UniOracle for a pair, records it in lookups/_pairs/_oracles; performs external contract creation.
External function that looks up the oracle for a pair and delegates to UniOracle.update via an external call.
View function that resolves an oracle by pair and delegates to UniOracle.consult for pricing.
View function returning the list of deployed oracle addresses.
View function returning the list of known pair addresses.
Helper returning block.timestamp truncated to uint32; the origin of the timestamp dependency.
Reads cumulative prices and reserves from the pair and mocks counterfactual accumulation using the timestamp delta.
Overflow-checked multiplication of a uq112x112 by a uint, returning uq144x112; used in consult.
Computes the ratio of two uint112 reserves as a uq112x112 fixed-point value; division guarded against zero.
Decodes a uq144x112 value back to a uint144 by right-shifting the resolution bits.
Computes the deterministic CREATE2 pair address from factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Sorts tokens, derives the pair and fetches/orders its reserves via an external call.
Computes the maximum output amount for a given input using fee-adjusted reserve arithmetic.
Computes the required input amount for a desired output using fee-adjusted reserve arithmetic.
Overflow-safe multiplication helper using the divide-back check.
Overflow-safe addition helper checking the result is not smaller than the operand.
Underflow-safe subtraction helper checking the result is not larger than the operand.
Block timestamp, a miner-influenceable value that drives the oracle averaging window and cumulative mocking.
uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) truncation in currentBlockTimestamp, making pricing dependent on block.timestamp.
Overflow/underflow-desired subtraction and division of cumulative prices by timeElapsed in update.
External calls to pair.price0CumulativeLast/price1CumulativeLast/getReserves in currentCumulativePrices; external contract interaction.
Multiplication-heavy price math in getAmountOut (amountInWithFee/reserves) that is overflow-sensitive if SafeMath is bypassed.
Contract creation (new UniOracle) inside deploy, an external callback surface invoked on construction.
External call UniOracle(...).update() in UniOracleFactory.update, an attacker-influenceable callback entrypoint.
External call UniOracle(...).consult() in UniOracleFactory.quote performed on an address resolved from lookups.
tokenA input of getPair/deploy/constructor passed into token sorting and pair derivation.
tokenB input of getPair/deploy/constructor passed into token sorting and pair derivation.
amountIn input of consult/quote used as the multiplier against the stored average price.
token selector parameter of consult, compared against token0/token1 to choose the average.
uint32 difference of blockTimestamp and blockTimestampLast, checked against PERIOD and used as divisor.
uint32 timestamp returned from currentCumulativePrices and consumed by update.
Fresh cumulative price0 fetched from the pair and used in the average computation.
Fresh cumulative price1 fetched from the pair and used in the average computation.
uint112 reserve0 fetched from the pair and validated non-zero in the UniOracle constructor.
uint112 reserve1 fetched from the pair and validated non-zero in the UniOracle constructor.

edges.reason: FACTORY constant is read as the factory argument of pairFor inside getPair.
FACTORY constant is read when deriving the pair and constructing UniOracle in deploy.
tokenA parameter flows into token sorting and CREATE2 derivation in pairFor.
tokenB parameter flows into token sorting and CREATE2 derivation in pairFor.
tokenA parameter is forwarded into pairFor from getPair.
tokenB parameter participates in the deploy pair derivation and oracle construction.
pairFor result is assigned to _pair and validated before oracle deployment in deploy.
lookups mapping is checked for an existing oracle and written with the new oracle address in deploy.
_oracles array is appended with the newly deployed oracle address in deploy.
_pairs array is appended with the newly derived pair address in deploy.
deploy performs contract creation (new UniOracle) whose constructor makes external calls to the pair.
lookups mapping resolves the oracle address that UniOracleFactory.update calls into.
getPair is invoked to derive the pair key before the oracle lookup in UniOracleFactory.update.
UniOracleFactory.update delegates to an external UniOracle.update call on an attacker-influenceable target.
lookups mapping resolves the oracle address that UniOracleFactory.quote delegates to.
getPair is invoked to derive the pair key before the oracle lookup in quote.
UniOracleFactory.quote performs an external call to UniOracle.consult on a lookups-resolved address.
amountIn parameter is multiplied against the stored average price in consult.
token parameter selects the token0/token1 branch and thus which average is used in consult.
amountIn parameter is forwarded to UniOracle.consult by quote.
token0 state variable is read to compare against the token argument in consult.
token1 state variable is read as the fallback branch comparison in consult.
price0Average state variable is consumed by mul/decode144 in consult.
price1Average state variable is consumed when token != token0 in consult.
consult calls FixedPoint.mul to combine the average with the input amount.
consult calls decode144 to convert the fixed-point product to a uint.
pair state variable is passed to currentCumulativePrices as the external call target in update.
pair state variable is assigned during construction from a newly derived pair address.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the fresh cumulative in update.
price1CumulativeLast is subtracted from the fresh cumulative in update.
blockTimestampLast is subtracted from the current timestamp to yield timeElapsed in update.
update writes the newly computed price0Average state variable.
update writes the newly computed price1Average state variable.
update stores the fresh price0Cumulative back into price0CumulativeLast.
update stores the fresh price1Cumulative back into price1CumulativeLast.
update advances blockTimestampLast to the current block timestamp.
timeElapsed local derived from the timestamp delta is used in the PERIOD require and as divisor in update.
blockTimestamp local returned from the library feeds the timeElapsed computation in update.
price0Cumulative local feeds the price0Average computation in update.
price1Cumulative local feeds the price1Average computation in update.
update invokes currentCumulativePrices to obtain fresh cumulative prices and timestamp.
update performs overflow-desired subtraction and division of cumulative prices by timeElapsed.
currentCumulativePrices calls currentBlockTimestamp to obtain the current timestamp.
currentBlockTimestamp reads block.timestamp, making oracle pricing miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is truncated modulo 2**32 into a uint32, a timestamp-dependency unsafe operation.
currentCumulativePrices relies on the truncated timestamp value for counterfactual accumulation.
currentCumulativePrices makes external staticcalls to pair.price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast and getReserves.
currentCumulativePrices obtains reserve values through getReserves.
currentCumulativePrices calls FixedPoint.fraction on the reserves to build the counterfactual price.
getReserves calls pairFor to derive the pair whose reserves are read.
getAmountOut multiplies fee-adjusted inputs and reserves, an overflow-sensitive arithmetic operation.
getAmountOut uses SafeMath.mul for the fee and reserve multiplications.
getAmountIn uses SafeMath.sub on reserveOut minus amountOut.
getAmountIn adds the rounding constant via SafeMath.add.
reserve0 local is read from getReserves and required non-zero in the UniOracle constructor.
reserve1 local is read from getReserves and required non-zero in the UniOracle constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenA is a pure input parameter that only feeds the pair derivation, so it collapses into UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
tokenB is a pure input parameter consumed by token sorting and CREATE2 derivation, so it collapses into UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
amountIn is only used as the multiplier against the stored average price, so it collapses into UniOracle.consult.
token is only used for the token0/token1 branch decision inside the pricing logic, so it collapses into UniOracle.consult.
timeElapsed is a transient computed delta used solely for the period check and divisor in update, so it merges into UniOracle.update.
blockTimestamp is a transient value consumed immediately by update to compute timeElapsed, so it merges into UniOracle.update.
price0Cumulative is a transient fetched value only used to write price0Average in update, so it merges into UniOracle.update.
price1Cumulative is a transient fetched value only used to write price1Average in update, so it merges into UniOracle.update.
reserve0 is a local only validated for non-zero liquidity in the constructor, so it merges into UniOracle.constructor.
reserve1 is a local only validated for non-zero liquidity in the constructor, so it merges into UniOracle.constructor.
